steps.note: K1.1 states the net target change (JV+RG)x is independent of the initial scratch values a,c (quote at paper line 749), and K1's motivation says the last two rows restore the scratch values.

K1.2 gives the central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 and that the side injection cancels exactly the intersection-one cases; K1.3 gives the net map y<-y+x, which carries the self coefficient one (not stated separately).
The plan never gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 or the side cancellation of intersections zero and two; K1.3 only asserts that both net maps are y<-y+x.
K1.4 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and K1 states that every scratch wire is restored by each invocation.
No step gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table); K3.3 only says triple lines are nondegenerate and neighbours orthogonal, and K3.6 names the decreasing edge.
The side edge 2->5 argument (t_X perp t_Y gives <t_X> inside t_Y^perp, complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2) does not appear anywhere in the plan.
K3.6 names center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h, K3.4 gives sources N, sinks Wm-N and signed Wm-2N, and K3.5 and K3.7 give absolute Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich.
Nothing in the plan argues that nonzero residuals over F_2 are nondegenerate and nonalternating or absorbs alternating planes; KB.1c merely assumes an orthonormal basis of each residual exists.
K3.8 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539.
The plan has no weight-additivity-mod-4 argument and no formula q_V-q_U = sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis; KB.1c and K3.11 only assert the resulting product of kernels / telescoped frame.
KB.1a and KB.1c state the kernel aI+bX_v as a result, but the plan never says wt(v) is odd, never writes the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, and never uses H diag(1,-1) H = X.
No step says that on k columns each residual vector gives one tensored factor; KB.1g counts s_c child calls on e/m axes, which is a different statement.

K3.11 asserts C^{tensor m} on every role, but the plan lacks the zero/full label endpoint frames, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and the negated X outputs; KB.1f's identity is for negative kernels, not this endpoint repair.
K3.8 gives both loss ratios below 1/2 and K3.10 and K3.12 give the positive deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c with s below Wm.
The value eta_b=339/22587335000000 is not stated anywhere in the plan.
The value eta_c=73/19906842167500 is not stated anywhere in the plan.
K3.13 fixes tau=sigma=1-2^-50, K3.14 gives deficits above 20*2^-50, log m<20 and m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-eta), and K3.15 concludes s/W<m^tau.

K4.1 and the K4 method only assert the factorization A=E1 Pi E2 with Pi having a ones; the elimination proof (pivot at topmost row's rightmost entry, lower-triangular clearing, repeat on active indices) is not given.
The plan mentions Z/q^b but never says a fixed odd prime is chosen to avoid every denominator in a finite table of factors so the identities specialize with invertible triangular factors.
K4.2 says only that the triangular parts cost O(V) and the K4 motivation alludes to the linear-time direction, but the descending-physical-order update that justifies the cost is not stated.
K4.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, a swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi and K4.4 gives one interchange per one, a in all.
The plan mentions C_1=20 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) fractional bits but never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} or C_0=128mB^2.
The plan has the time recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+... (KB.3f) but no arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, A(e)<=8e at a leaf, or the per-invocation count below E.
No unrolling of the depth recurrence (B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}) or total below C_0 d^{C_1} appears in the plan.

KB.4c states p+ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) fractional bits and o(p) extra since eps*C_1<1, but the depth-l invariant (2^{-(p+l)}Z[i], modulus at most 2^l) and the Delta+3 integer bits that make it exact are not stated.
KB.4d states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so H maps disk arrays to disk arrays and truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: Present for 9 of 26: B1, B2, B4, L3, L5, R1, R4, M4, S5. The plan carries the bank-exchange bit case and three-stage schedule, the dimension telescoping and loss ratios, the exponent choice and its inequality chain, the one-interchange-per-one shear step and the row-sum-one fact. It misses nearly all of the proof-level content: the complex-case coefficients (B3), the residual table, side-edge and F_2 orthonormal-basis arguments (L1, L2, L4), the whole phase interface (P1-P4), the explicit eta values (R2, R3), the matrix-shear elimination proof, prime choice and descending-order cost (M1-M3), and the whole guard-width derivation (S1-S4).
